import os,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
pids=[]
unreadable=0
for p in Path("/proc").iterdir():
 if not p.name.isdigit(): continue
 try:
  proc=(p/"comm").read_text(errors="replace").strip()
  if proc.lower() not in ("python","python3","node","nodejs","codex","bash","sh"): continue
  raw=(p/"cmdline").read_bytes().replace(b"\x00",b" ").decode("utf-8","replace")
 except (OSError,PermissionError):
  unreadable+=1
  continue
 if re.search(r'(?i)(?:^|[ /])(?:ops/)?coordinator_ai\.py(?:\s|$)|-m\s+ops\.coordinator_ai(?:\s|$)|/coordinator-smoke-remote\.sh(?:\s|$)',raw):
  if p.name not in (str(os.getpid()),str(os.getppid())):
   pids.append((int(p.name),proc))
print("VPS_COORDINATOR_EXECUTION_PROCESSES",len(pids),flush=True)
for pid,proc in pids:print("VPS_COORDINATOR_PROCESS",pid,proc,flush=True)
print("VPS_PROCESS_INSPECTION_UNREADABLE",unreadable,flush=True)
try:
 result=subprocess.run(["systemctl","list-units","--all","--type=service","--no-pager","--no-legend"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=15)
 if result.returncode==0:
  names=[line.split()[0] for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if line.split() and re.search('(?i)(coordinator|project.leader)',line.split()[0])]
  print("VPS_COORDINATOR_SYSTEMD_UNITS",names,flush=True)
 else: print("VPS_SYSTEMD_UNAVAILABLE",result.returncode,flush=True)
except (OSError,subprocess.TimeoutExpired) as exc:print("VPS_SYSTEMD_UNAVAILABLE",type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
for target in ("/home/ubuntu/codex-bridge","/home/ubuntu/codex-agent"):
 folder=Path(target)
 if folder.is_dir():
  modules=[str(x.relative_to(folder)) for x in folder.glob("**/coordinator_ai.py") if len(x.parts)-len(folder.parts)<=6]
  print("VPS_LEGACY_MODULE_COPIES",target,len(modules),modules[:12],flush=True)
 else: print("VPS_LEGACY_FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE",target,flush=True)
print("VPS_POSTMERGE_LIVE_INSPECTION_DONE",flush=True)
